answer: Payout travels as a voyage: the claim's funds hop through strangers, each hop verifying one job and staking a deposit, paid only if the hop checks out. Each hop must cross a ridge: the stranger's reputation must clear an altitude rising with every concurrent voyage from the same funding trail, so the k-th clone needs k times the reputation, and high strangers charge more and refuse lookalikes. Voyages sharing a hop merge into one, and a failed hop sends a ripple back, reversing the voyage and burning the sender's bond. N clones pay n voyages and rising ridge tolls for one prize.
